description:
Hinagiku lost her only family member, her mother, in an accident when she was a child. On a long and lonely rainy season night, little Hinagiku played her flute alone. Her only support was her best friend, Dahlia, who came to her every time she heard the sound. More than ten years have passed since Dahlia left for Brazil, her mother's homeland. As an adult, Hinagiku lives with her aunt and uncle in their restaurant, making Yakisoba. One day during the rainy season, in the same downpour as the night Hinagiku lost her mother, a news arrives from Brazil. That news describes the supernatural connection between two lonely souls, far away from each other and never to be seen again―――.

(Source: amepippin)
